content_sections.heading: Telangana Anganwadi Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: As per the official vacancy list issued by the District Welfare Officer, WCD & SC, Telangana Anganwadi, a total of 41 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) vacancies and 11 Anganwadi Helper (AWH) vacancies are available across two ICDS projects: Bhupalpally (12 Anganwadi Centres) and Mahadevpur (29 Anganwadi Centres). The reservation category shown against each Anganwadi Centre applies to the AWT post; the source list does not clearly separate a reservation category for the AWH vacancies at each centre, so that detail is not stated here. Candidates should apply only for the Anganwadi Centre corresponding to their own village/Gram Panchayat, since the local residency condition explained below restricts eligibility to that specific centre.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Anganwadi AWT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Anganwadi Teacher posts must have passed Intermediate (12th class) or an equivalent qualification. The notification does not specify a separate qualification requirement for Anganwadi Helper (AWH) posts. Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date. Only women candidates can apply. In addition, the notification lays down a local residency condition: for the Anganwadi Teacher post, only women who are permanent residents of the specific village/ward covered by that Anganwadi Centre are eligible to apply for the post at that centre. For rural areas, residency within the Gram Panchayat area of the concerned Anganwadi Centre is required. A related condition in the notification also indicates that, for certain posts, only candidates already residing within the same Gram Panchayat/village from which the vacancy has arisen are eligible; the exact wording of this clause is not fully legible in the scanned notification, so candidates should verify this condition on the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Anganwadi AWT Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the notification, candidates for the Anganwadi Teacher post will be selected based on a merit list prepared out of a total of 70 marks. The broad basis for these marks, as stated in the notification, includes: Merit based on Intermediate (12th class) marks Additional weightage marks for certain special categories, including widows and orphans Marks for an interview conducted by the District Selection Committee The exact mark-wise break-up for each special category is not fully legible in the scanned notification, so candidates are advised to verify the complete selection criteria from the official notification or the WCD Telangana website before applying. As noted above, eligibility for each Anganwadi Centre is further restricted to women who are permanent residents of that centre’s village/Gram Panchayat area.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Telangana Anganwadi AWT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in online mode. Offline or physical applications are not accepted as per the notification. Visit the official WCD Telangana website at https://wdcw.tg.nic.in/ . Locate the Telangana Anganwadi AWT Recruitment 2026 online application link on the website. Select the Anganwadi Centre corresponding to your own village/Gram Panchayat, as per the residency condition explained in the eligibility section. Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and residency details. Upload the required supporting documents/certificates as prescribed on the application portal. Review the filled application carefully and submit it before 02.09.2026, 5:00 PM. The notification does not list the specific documents required to be uploaded; candidates should check the application portal for the exact document checklist. faq.question: Q1. What is Jayashankar Bhupalpally AWT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification (No. A/1137/2026, dated 20.08.2026) issued by the WCD & SC Department, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District, to fill Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) posts, along with some Anganwadi Helper (AWH) vacancies, on a temporary basis in the Bhupalpally and Mahadevpur ICDS projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 41 Anganwadi Teacher (AWT) vacancies and 11 Anganwadi Helper (AWH) vacancies across 41 Anganwadi Centres in the district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 02.09.2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (12th class) or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01.07.2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official WCD Telangana website, https://wdcw.tg.nic.in/, before the last date.
